title: Elisha the Prophet Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Elisha the Prophet Bible Crossword
description: Solve an Elisha Bible crossword: the mantle and the double portion, the widow’s oil, Naaman in Jordan, and the chariots of fire. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: He asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit, watches the chariot of fire go up, and picks the mantle off the ground. Elisha the Prophet covers the miracles that follow through 2 Kings — the waters healed with salt, the widow's pot of oil that fills every vessel she can borrow, the Shunammite's son, the axe head that swims.
It's in the Hard tier because the stories are many and rarely retold. The closing verse is the moment the Shunammite's son is given back to her.

clues.text: Syrian captain healed of his leprosy
River he was told to wash in seven times
What he asked a double portion of

verseText: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
